meaning.en: The great Empress of the universe

explanation.en: Mahārājñī means a great queen, an empress. Having called her Mother, the hymn now calls her Ruler: she cares for the universe as a mother and governs it as an empress.

inner.en: As Empress she holds the whole cosmic order together. Read inwardly, she is the one awareness that rules every faculty in us; senses, mind and breath all work under her command.

story.en: Commentators read the first three names together as her three cosmic acts: as Mother she creates, as Empress she sustains, and as Queen of the lion-throne she dissolves. This second name is the power that sustains.
